title: Red Velvet cake near Greystanes or Smithfield? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Red Velvet cake for Greystanes or Smithfield, with no egg anywhere in it? Harris Park bakes it.

Soft crumb, cream cheese style finish, and an eggless sponge that holds up when the party runs late. Every Num Num's cake is 100% eggless, so nobody at the table has to ask what is in it.

Order two days ahead. Collect from Wigram Street, Harris Park, 11am to 10pm. A 6-inch starts at $39.99 and a 10-inch at $74.99 serves 20 to 22.

Have a photo or a design in mind? Send it with the order.
